_comment: Values a newly created RSZ instance starts with where its type's zero default differs from what shipped files hold.
Keyed by type name. Each entry lists the names the field goes by across the games' type dumps (the first one an
instance has is set); a list value sets the vector components x, y, z, w in order.
Surveyed 2026-10-16 on the scn/pfb fixtures of all 21 dumps: GameObjects hold Update/Draw true and TimeScale -1;
folders with children hold Update/Draw/Startup (Standby) true; Transforms hold identity rotation and unit scale.
